targets.expr: max by (name) (hc_check_up) + 2 * max by (name) (hc_check_grace) + 4 * max by (name) (hc_check_started) + 8 * max by (name) (hc_check_paused)

targets.root_selector: data.groups.( $i := interval; rules.{ "rule": name, "severity": labels.severity, "state": state = "inactive" ? "normal" : state, "health": health, "every": $string($i) & " s", "last": $toMillis(lastEvaluation), "next": $toMillis(lastEvaluation) + $i * 1000, "error": lastError } )
